name: LevshAi
full_name: LevshAi intelligent robotic motion-copying system for endovascular neurosurgery
group: Neurosputnik LLC with MIPT, NUST MISIS and Moscow State University (I. Menshikov, A. Bernadotte)
versions: 2023 IEEE CBS system paper (full); 2023 ICARA personalised 3-D vascular simulator (title)
devices_driven: catheters and guidewires; dispenser for gel; coil installation on the control side (Sec. II)
n_dof_detail: N.R. (axial movement and rotation of catheters)
force_sensing: optical motion encoders and piezo sensors along the catheter detect twisting and vibration (Sec. II-C)
haptics_leader: leader identical to a real catheter and torquer; stepper motors render twist resistance, linear miniature solenoids render wall contact, LED force scale
imaging_compat: X-ray fluoroscopy; AI processing of fluoroscopy
validation_detail: tested by surgeons of the Russian Endovascular Neuro Society, qualitative only (Sec. I)
sim_model: personalised 3-D vascular simulator built from patient images (menshikov2023_preoperative, title; CBS Sec. II-E)
